examples.en: She cut the paper into thin strips for the art project.
examples.zh: 她把紙剪成細長條，用來做美勞作業。

examples.en: A narrow strip of grass ran along the fence.
examples.zh: 一條狹長的草地沿著圍籬延伸。

examples.en: Tear off a strip of tape and seal the box.
examples.zh: 撕下一段膠帶把箱子封好。

examples.en: Please strip the old paint from the chair before you repaint it.
examples.zh: 重新上漆前，請先把椅子上的舊漆刮掉。

examples.en: He stripped off his wet jacket before entering the house.
examples.zh: 他進屋前脫掉了濕外套。

examples.en: He began to strip the bark from the branch.
examples.zh: 他開始剝掉樹枝上的樹皮。

examples.en: The structure of this essay is clear and easy to follow.
examples.zh: 這篇文章的結構清楚，很容易理解。

examples.en: The old structure by the river was built in 1900.
examples.zh: 河邊那棟老建築建於一九〇〇年。

examples.en: Scientists study the structure of the human brain.
examples.zh: 科學家研究人類大腦的構造。

examples.en: You should structure your speech with a clear beginning and ending.
examples.zh: 你應該讓演講有清楚的開頭和結尾。

examples.en: The teacher will structure the lesson around group work.
examples.zh: 老師會以小組活動為主來安排這堂課。

examples.en: We structure our meetings so everyone can speak.
examples.zh: 我們安排會議的方式，是讓每個人都能發言。

senses.zh: 頑固的；固執的；難以去除的

examples.en: My grandfather is too stubborn to see a doctor.
examples.zh: 我爺爺太固執了，不肯去看醫生。

examples.en: The stubborn stain would not come out of my shirt.
examples.zh: 我襯衫上這塊頑固的汙漬怎麼洗也洗不掉。

examples.en: She was stubborn and refused to change her plan.
examples.zh: 她很固執，不肯改變計畫。

examples.en: The artist painted all day in her small studio.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家整天在她的小工作室裡畫畫。

examples.en: The band is recording a new song at the studio.
examples.zh: 樂團正在錄音室錄製新歌。

examples.en: He rented a studio near the MRT station.
examples.zh: 他在捷運站附近租了一間套房。

examples.en: Please put your stuff in the locker before class.
examples.zh: 上課前請把你的東西放進置物櫃。

examples.en: There is a lot of heavy stuff in this box.
examples.zh: 這個箱子裡有很多沉重的東西。

examples.en: I love the stuff you bought for the party.
examples.zh: 我很喜歡你為派對買的那些東西。

examples.en: She tried to stuff too many clothes into the suitcase.
examples.zh: 她想把太多衣服塞進行李箱。

examples.en: We stuff the turkey with rice and vegetables.
examples.zh: 我們在火雞裡塞滿米飯和蔬菜。

examples.en: He stuffed the letter into his pocket and left.
examples.zh: 他把信塞進口袋就離開了。

examples.en: Water is a substance that can be a liquid, a solid, or a gas.
examples.zh: 水是一種物質，可以是液體、固體或氣體。

examples.en: The report has style, but it lacks substance.
examples.zh: 這份報告有風格，但缺乏實質內容。

examples.en: Always read the label on any chemical substance.
examples.zh: 使用任何化學物質前，都要先閱讀標示。

examples.en: Subtract five from ten and you get five.
examples.zh: 十減五等於五。

examples.en: The store will subtract the discount from your final bill.
examples.zh: 商店會從你的總帳單中扣除折扣。

examples.en: Students learn to add and subtract in the first grade.
examples.zh: 學生在一年級就學習加法和減法。

examples.en: My family moved to a quiet suburb of Taipei last year.
examples.zh: 我們家去年搬到台北一個安靜的郊區。

examples.en: Many people who work downtown live in the suburbs.
examples.zh: 許多在市區工作的人住在郊區。

examples.en: The bus takes about an hour to reach the suburb.
examples.zh: 公車大約要一小時才會到那個郊區。

examples.en: The baby likes to suck on a soft toy.
examples.zh: 寶寶喜歡吸吮柔軟的玩具。

examples.en: Use a straw to suck up the last bit of juice.
examples.zh: 用吸管把最後一點果汁吸起來。

examples.en: This machine can suck dust out of the carpet.
examples.zh: 這台機器能把地毯裡的灰塵吸走。

examples.en: Many people suffer from headaches during the exam season.
examples.zh: 許多人在考試季節會頭痛。

examples.en: The town suffered serious damage in the storm.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮在暴風雨中受到嚴重的損害。

examples.en: I hate to see animals suffer, so I volunteer at a shelter.
examples.zh: 我不忍心看到動物受苦，所以到收容所當志工。

examples.en: We have sufficient food for the whole class.
examples.zh: 我們有足夠的食物給全班同學。

examples.en: Is one hour sufficient time to finish the test?
examples.zh: 一小時的時間足夠寫完這份考卷嗎？

examples.en: There was not sufficient light to take a good photo.
examples.zh: 光線不足，沒辦法拍出好照片。

examples.en: The school runs a program on suicide prevention for students.
examples.zh: 學校為學生辦理自殺防治的課程。

examples.en: Experts say talking openly can help prevent suicide.
examples.zh: 專家說坦誠交談有助於預防自殺。

examples.en: If you worry about suicide, please call a help line.
examples.zh: 如果你擔心有人想自殺，請撥打協談專線。

examples.en: The sum of three and four is seven.
examples.zh: 三加四的總和是七。

examples.en: She paid a large sum of money for the old piano.
examples.zh: 她花了一大筆錢買下那架舊鋼琴。

examples.en: The children are practicing simple sums in math class.
examples.zh: 孩子們正在數學課練習簡單的算術題。

examples.en: Let me sum up the main points of today's lesson.
examples.zh: 讓我來總結今天這堂課的重點。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to sum up the story in one sentence.
examples.zh: 老師要我們用一句話總結這個故事。

examples.en: These small costs sum to more than we expected.
examples.zh: 這些小開銷加起來比我們預期的還多。

examples.en: Please write a short summary of the article.
examples.zh: 請為這篇文章寫一份簡短的摘要。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a summary of the lesson at the end of class.
examples.zh: 下課前，老師為我們總結了這堂課的內容。

examples.en: Read the summary first to get the main idea.
examples.zh: 先看摘要掌握大意。

examples.en: We reached the summit just before sunrise.
examples.zh: 我們在日出前不久抵達山頂。

examples.en: The leaders will meet at a summit in Tokyo next month.
examples.zh: 各國領袖下個月將在東京的高峰會上會面。

examples.en: Reaching the summit was the best moment of the trip.
examples.zh: 登上山頂是這趟旅程最棒的時刻。

senses.zh: 較優越的；上等的；較高級的

examples.en: This brand makes a superior product at a fair price.
examples.zh: 這個品牌以合理的價格製造出品質較好的產品。

examples.en: Her English is superior to mine because she practices every day.
examples.zh: 她每天練習，所以英文比我好。

examples.en: The hotel offers superior service to every guest.
examples.zh: 這間飯店為每位房客提供上等的服務。

examples.en: You should report the problem to your superior.
examples.zh: 你應該把這個問題向你的上司報告。

examples.en: The new manager is my direct superior.
examples.zh: 新來的經理是我的直屬上司。

examples.en: A good superior listens to the team.
examples.zh: 好的上司會傾聽團隊的意見。

examples.en: Tall mountains surround the small village, making it difficult to reach.
examples.zh: 高山環繞這個小村莊，使人難以抵達。

examples.en: Fans surrounded the singer as she left the building.
examples.zh: 歌手走出大樓時，歌迷把她團團圍住。

examples.en: A beautiful garden surrounds the school and provides space for outdoor lessons.
examples.zh: 一座美麗的花園環繞學校，提供戶外上課的空間。

examples.en: The school did a survey about students' favorite lunches.
examples.zh: 學校做了一份學生最愛午餐的問卷調查。

examples.en: Please fill out this short survey after your visit.
examples.zh: 參觀後請填寫這份簡短的問卷。

examples.en: A survey of the land took two weeks.
examples.zh: 這片土地的測量花了兩個星期。

examples.en: The company will survey customers about the new app.
examples.zh: 公司會就新應用程式調查顧客的意見。

examples.en: He stood at the door and surveyed the crowded room.
examples.zh: 他站在門口，環視擁擠的房間。

examples.en: Engineers came to survey the site before building.
examples.zh: 工程師在興建前來勘查工地。

examples.en: The survivor of the shipwreck was found on a small island.
examples.zh: 那場船難的倖存者在一座小島上被找到。

examples.en: She is a cancer survivor who now helps other patients.
examples.zh: 她是一名癌症存活者，如今會幫助其他病人。

examples.en: Rescue teams searched the area for survivors.
examples.zh: 救難隊在該地區搜尋生還者。

examples.en: I suspect that he forgot about the meeting.
examples.zh: 我猜他忘了開會這件事。

examples.en: The teacher suspected that someone had copied the answer.
examples.zh: 老師懷疑有人抄襲了答案。

examples.en: Do you suspect something is wrong with the engine?
examples.zh: 你懷疑引擎有問題嗎？

examples.en: Police questioned a suspect about the missing bike.
examples.zh: 警方就失竊的腳踏車詢問了一名嫌疑人。

examples.en: The main suspect had a good reason to be at the shop.
examples.zh: 主要嫌疑人有正當理由出現在那間店裡。

examples.en: No suspect has been found yet, so the investigation continues.
examples.zh: 目前還沒找到嫌疑人，因此調查仍在進行。

examples.en: I have a suspicion that she already knows the secret.
examples.zh: 我懷疑她早就知道這個秘密了。

examples.en: The strange noise raised the guard's suspicion.
examples.zh: 奇怪的聲音引起警衛的懷疑。

examples.en: He looked at the stranger with suspicion.
examples.zh: 他以懷疑的眼神看著那個陌生人。

examples.en: I swear I will keep your secret.
examples.zh: 我發誓會替你保守秘密。

examples.en: The new mayor will swear to serve the city.
examples.zh: 新市長將宣誓為這座城市服務。

examples.en: Please do not swear in front of the children.
examples.zh: 請不要在孩子面前說髒話。

examples.en: Sweat ran down his face after the long run.
examples.zh: 長跑之後，汗水順著他的臉流下來。

examples.en: She wiped the sweat from her forehead with a towel.
examples.zh: 她用毛巾擦掉額頭上的汗。

examples.en: The smell of sweat filled the gym.
examples.zh: 健身房裡充滿汗味。

examples.en: I always sweat a lot in the summer.
examples.zh: 我夏天總是很會流汗。

examples.en: The players began to sweat in the hot sun.
examples.zh: 球員們在大太陽下開始流汗。

examples.en: Don't sweat it; we still have plenty of time.
examples.zh: 別擔心，時間還很充裕。

examples.en: My ankle began to swell after I fell.
examples.zh: 我跌倒後，腳踝開始腫起來。

examples.en: The river will swell after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，河水會暴漲。

examples.en: The crowd swelled as the concert time came near.
examples.zh: 音樂會時間逼近，人群越聚越多。

examples.en: The boat rose and fell on the ocean swell.
examples.zh: 小船隨著海上的湧浪起伏。

examples.en: There was a swell of applause at the end.
examples.zh: 結束時響起一陣熱烈的掌聲。

examples.en: The swell of the sea made us feel sick.
examples.zh: 海上的大浪讓我們覺得很不舒服。

examples.en: The company made a swift decision to fix the problem.
examples.zh: 公司迅速做出決定來解決問題。

examples.en: The swift runner won the race easily.
examples.zh: 那位跑得很快的選手輕鬆贏得比賽。

examples.en: We were thankful for the swift reply to our email.
examples.zh: 我們很感謝我們的電子郵件獲得迅速回覆。

examples.en: The museum has an old sword from the 1600s.
examples.zh: 博物館收藏了一把十七世紀的古劍。

examples.en: Actors used a wooden sword in the school play.
examples.zh: 演員在學校的戲劇中使用木劍。

examples.en: The knight in the story carried a long sword.
examples.zh: 故事裡的騎士帶著一把長劍。

examples.en: My little brother watches cartoons on a tablet.
examples.zh: 我弟弟用平板電腦看卡通。

examples.en: The doctor told me to take one tablet after each meal.
examples.zh: 醫生告訴我每餐飯後服用一顆藥片。

examples.en: An ancient stone tablet was found near the temple.
examples.zh: 寺廟附近發現了一塊古老的石碑。

examples.en: The price tag says this jacket costs 800 dollars.
examples.zh: 價格標籤上寫著這件外套要八百元。

examples.en: Please write your name on the luggage tag.
examples.zh: 請在行李吊牌上寫下你的名字。

examples.en: Each plant has a small tag with its name.
examples.zh: 每株植物都有一個寫著名稱的小標籤。

examples.en: Please tag your friends in the photo.
examples.zh: 請在照片中標註你的朋友。

examples.en: The shop will tag every item with a price.
examples.zh: 商店會替每件商品貼上價格標籤。

examples.en: Scientists tag the birds to follow their travels.
examples.zh: 科學家為鳥類加上標記，以追蹤牠們的遷徙。

examples.en: The tailor measured my arms for the new suit.
examples.zh: 裁縫師為了新西裝量了我的手臂長度。

examples.en: My father took the pants to a tailor to shorten them.
examples.zh: 我爸爸把褲子拿去給裁縫師修短。

examples.en: She works as a tailor in a small shop.
examples.zh: 她在一間小店裡擔任裁縫師。

examples.en: The school tries to tailor lessons to each student.
examples.zh: 學校努力依每位學生的需求設計課程。

examples.en: We can tailor the trip to your needs.
examples.zh: 我們可以依你的需求量身安排行程。

examples.en: He had the jacket tailored to fit him perfectly.
examples.zh: 他把外套訂做成完全合身的樣子。

examples.en: The tame rabbit lets the children pick it up.
examples.zh: 這隻溫馴的兔子讓孩子們抱起牠。

examples.en: A tame bird sat on her shoulder.
examples.zh: 一隻馴養的鳥停在她的肩膀上。

examples.en: Wild animals are not tame, so keep your distance.
examples.zh: 野生動物並不溫馴，所以要保持距離。

examples.en: It takes patience to tame a wild horse.
examples.zh: 馴服野馬需要耐心。

examples.en: The farmer managed to tame the young dog.
examples.zh: 農夫成功馴服了那隻小狗。

examples.en: People first tried to tame wolves thousands of years ago.
examples.zh: 人類在數千年前就開始嘗試馴養狼。

examples.en: Turn off the tap while you brush your teeth.
examples.zh: 刷牙時請關上水龍頭。

examples.en: Water from the tap is safe to drink after boiling.
examples.zh: 水龍頭的水煮沸後可以安全飲用。

examples.en: I heard a soft tap on the door.
examples.zh: 我聽到輕輕的敲門聲。

examples.en: Tap the screen twice to open the app.
examples.zh: 在螢幕上輕點兩下就能開啟應用程式。

examples.en: She tapped me on the shoulder to get my attention.
examples.zh: 她輕拍我的肩膀來引起我的注意。

examples.en: The town wants to tap solar power.
examples.zh: 這個城鎮想開發太陽能。

examples.en: The soup was hot and very tasty.
examples.zh: 這碗湯又熱又好喝。

examples.en: Mom made a tasty dinner for the whole family.
examples.zh: 媽媽為全家人做了一頓美味的晚餐。

examples.en: These tasty cookies are my favorite snack.
examples.zh: 這些好吃的餅乾是我最愛的點心。

examples.en: Please do not tease your little sister about her hair.
examples.zh: 請不要拿你妹妹的頭髮取笑她。

examples.en: My friends tease me because I always sing in the shower.
examples.zh: 朋友們取笑我老是在洗澡時唱歌。

examples.en: He likes to tease the cat with a piece of string.
examples.zh: 他喜歡用一條繩子逗貓。

examples.en: The company is looking for someone with technical skills.
examples.zh: 公司正在找具備技術能力的人。

examples.en: A technical problem delayed the online class.
examples.zh: 一個技術問題使線上課程延遲了。

examples.en: The manual is full of technical terms.
examples.zh: 這份手冊充滿專業術語。

examples.en: The teacher showed us a new technique for solving math problems.
examples.zh: 老師教我們一個解數學題的新技巧。

examples.en: She uses a special painting technique to create realistic shadows.
examples.zh: 她運用一種特別的繪畫技巧，畫出逼真的陰影。

examples.en: Good study techniques can save a lot of time.
examples.zh: 好的讀書技巧能省下許多時間。

examples.en: My teenage cousin spends hours on her phone.
examples.zh: 我十幾歲的表姊花好幾個小時滑手機。

examples.en: The shop sells clothes for teenage girls.
examples.zh: 這家店販售青少女的服飾。

examples.en: Teenage students often feel pressure before exams.
examples.zh: 青少年學生在考試前常會感到壓力。

examples.en: My brother has a bad temper when he is tired.
examples.zh: 我哥哥累的時候脾氣很差。

examples.en: She tried hard not to lose her temper in class.
examples.zh: 她努力不要在課堂上發脾氣。

examples.en: Keeping your temper helps you solve problems calmly.
examples.zh: 保持冷靜有助於你平心靜氣地解決問題。

examples.en: The teacher tried to temper her words with kindness.
examples.zh: 老師試著以善意緩和她的措辭。

examples.en: Add a little sugar to temper the sour taste.
examples.zh: 加一點糖來調和酸味。

examples.en: Experience will temper his excitement and help him make realistic plans.
examples.zh: 經驗會使他不再那麼興奮，並幫助他擬定切合實際的計畫。

examples.en: This is only a temporary fix, so we need a better plan.
examples.zh: 這只是暫時的修補辦法，所以我們需要更好的計畫。

examples.en: He found a temporary job during the summer vacation.
examples.zh: 他在暑假找到一份臨時工作。

examples.en: The road will have a temporary closure on Sunday.
examples.zh: 這條路星期日會暫時封閉。

examples.en: Prices tend to rise before the holidays.
examples.zh: 假期前物價往往會上漲。

examples.en: I tend to get sleepy after lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐後常常會想睡。

examples.en: She tends the garden every evening after work.
examples.zh: 她每天傍晚下班後都會照料花園。

examples.en: The beef was so tender that it melted in my mouth.
examples.zh: 這塊牛肉很嫩，入口即化。

examples.en: She gave the baby a tender kiss.
examples.zh: 她溫柔地親了寶寶一下。

examples.en: My knee is still tender after the game.
examples.zh: 比賽後，我的膝蓋觸碰時仍會痛。

examples.en: The country sent a team to inspect its territory.
examples.zh: 這個國家派了一支隊伍去勘查其領土。

examples.en: Lions mark their territory to keep other animals away.
examples.zh: 獅子標記自己的地盤，以趕走其他動物。

examples.en: Space travel is still new territory for our company.
examples.zh: 太空旅行對我們公司來說仍是新領域。

examples.en: I am thankful for your help with my homework.
examples.zh: 我很感謝你幫忙我寫功課。

examples.en: They were thankful that the weather was clear for the trip.
examples.zh: 他們慶幸旅行當天天氣晴朗。

examples.en: She felt thankful to have such good friends.
examples.zh: 她很感激能有這麼好的朋友。

examples.en: Einstein's theory changed the way we see time.
examples.zh: 愛因斯坦的理論改變了我們看待時間的方式。

examples.en: In theory, the plan should work well.
examples.zh: 理論上，這個計畫應該行得通。

examples.en: My theory is that he missed the bus.
examples.zh: 我的猜測是他錯過了公車。

examples.en: A cold drink can quench your thirst on a hot day.
examples.zh: 在大熱天，一杯冷飲可以解渴。

examples.en: The runner drank water to satisfy his thirst.
examples.zh: 跑者喝水來解渴。

examples.en: She has a thirst for knowledge and reads widely every day.
examples.zh: 她渴求知識，每天都廣泛閱讀。

examples.en: She needs a needle and some red thread to fix the button.
examples.zh: 她需要針和一些紅線來縫好鈕釦。

examples.en: I lost the thread of the story during the talk.
examples.zh: 演講時我跟丟了故事的脈絡。

examples.en: A thread of light came through the curtain.
examples.zh: 一道細細的光從窗簾透進來。

examples.en: Can you thread this needle for me?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我把針穿好線嗎？

examples.en: He threaded his way through the busy crowd.
examples.zh: 他穿過擁擠的人群前進。

examples.en: She threaded the beads onto a string.
examples.zh: 她把珠子串在一條線上。

examples.en: Pollution is a serious threat to our health.
examples.zh: 汙染是對我們健康的嚴重威脅。

examples.en: The company faces a threat from new competitors.
examples.zh: 這間公司面臨新競爭者的威脅。

examples.en: Dark clouds were a threat to our picnic.
examples.zh: 烏雲對我們的野餐構成威脅。

examples.en: Heavy rain may threaten the farmers' crops.
examples.zh: 大雨可能會威脅農民的作物。

examples.en: The boss did not threaten anyone; he only gave a warning.
examples.zh: 老闆沒有威脅任何人，只是提出警告。

examples.en: Dark clouds threaten a storm this afternoon.
examples.zh: 烏雲預示今天下午會有暴風雨。

examples.en: The tide is low, so we can walk on the beach.
examples.zh: 現在潮位低，所以我們可以在海灘上走。

examples.en: Fishing boats go out when the tide comes in.
examples.zh: 漲潮時，漁船會出海。

examples.en: The tide of public opinion is changing.
examples.zh: 民意的趨勢正在改變。

examples.en: These shoes are too tight for my feet.
examples.zh: 這雙鞋對我的腳來說太緊了。

examples.en: Our schedule is tight this week because of the upcoming conference.
examples.zh: 因為即將舉行研討會，我們這星期的行程很緊湊。

examples.en: Money is tight this month, so we will eat at home.
examples.zh: 這個月手頭很緊，所以我們在家吃飯。

examples.en: Hold tight to the handle on the bus.
examples.zh: 在公車上要緊緊抓住把手。

examples.en: She closed the lid tight so nothing would spill.
examples.zh: 她把蓋子蓋緊，以免東西灑出來。

examples.en: Sleep tight, and I will see you at breakfast tomorrow.
examples.zh: 睡個好覺，我明天早餐時會見到你。

examples.en: Please tighten the screw so the shelf does not fall.
examples.zh: 請把螺絲鎖緊，這樣架子才不會掉下來。

examples.en: The government will tighten rules for food safety.
examples.zh: 政府將加強食品安全的規定。

examples.en: He tightened his belt before running to keep his pants in place.
examples.zh: 他跑步前把皮帶繫緊，以免褲子滑落。
